relevance.title: Inflation relevance
relevance.meaning: Identifies institutional items about inflation. Keeps the measure focused on the research question.
relevance.construction: Apply the study’s relevance classification before weighting an item.
relevance.limitations: Classification can confuse adjacent economic topics with inflation.

prominence.title: Institutional prominence
prominence.meaning: Describes how prominently an institution appears in an item. Distinguishes a central role from a passing mention.
prominence.construction: Salience = 0.30 × title + 0.25 × position + 0.20 × mention-frequency rank + 0.25 × agency cue.
prominence.limitations: Automated cues can misread context or attribute a statement to another central bank.

reach.title: Potential reach
reach.meaning: An estimate of an item’s potential audience. Gives differently sized outlets different contributions.
reach.construction: Multiply each relevant institutional item’s salience by its potential reach.
reach.limitations: Potential audiences can overlap; reach does not measure reading or understanding.

share.title: Weighted visibility
share.meaning: The institution’s weighted share of the inflation discussion. Relates institutional presence to the size of the surrounding debate.
share.construction: 100 × sum of institutional salience × reach, divided by (sum of inflation-corpus reach + 1). Unit: percent.
share.limitations: The denominator can grow even when institutional coverage stays constant.

gap.title: Attention gap
gap.meaning: The same visibility information relative to a fixed historical reference. Matches the manuscript’s terminology and coefficient tables.
gap.construction: Baseline share minus current share, in percentage points. A larger gap means lower visibility.
gap.limitations: A baseline is a reference; it is not an institutional target.

centrality.title: Network centrality
centrality.meaning: The institution’s position among actors linked through media sources. Asks about network position, a different question from share of coverage.
centrality.construction: Eigenvector centrality gives more weight to connections with well-connected actors and is normalised within each monthly network.
centrality.limitations: Network composition and normalisation can change a score; centrality does not measure trust.

expectations.title: Consumer expectations
expectations.meaning: A monthly survey balance describing expected price movements. Examines whether media measures predict a separate household outcome.
expectations.construction: Compare monthly projections with weekly models using linear or step assignment of the monthly survey.
expectations.limitations: Assignment to weeks creates no new survey responses. The balance does not measure long-term anchoring.

article.title: Article share
article.meaning: How many inflation-relevant institutional items appear relative to the inflation corpus?
article.construction: 100 × relevant institutional item count / (inflation item count + 1). It does not apply prominence or reach weights.
article.limitations: Counts publication instances; repeated publication is not independent editorial attention.

hhi.title: Concentration of institutional weight
hhi.meaning: How concentrated is the visibility numerator across source labels?
hhi.construction: Sum the squared source shares of the salience × reach numerator. A value of 1 means one source carries all weight.
hhi.limitations: Source labels are not necessarily independent brands or owners. This weighted-numerator diagnostic differs from the broad source-reach HHI used as a regression control.

relevance.title: Relevantnost za inflaciju
relevance.meaning: Objava iz institucionalnog korpusa koja se bavi inflacijom. Usmjerava pokazatelj na predmet istraživanja.
relevance.construction: Prije ponderiranja primjenjuje se klasifikacija relevantnosti.
relevance.limitations: Srodne gospodarske teme mogu se pogrešno prepoznati kao inflacija.

prominence.title: Institucionalna istaknutost
prominence.meaning: Mjesto institucije u medijskom tekstu. Razlikuje središnju ulogu od usputnog spominjanja.
prominence.construction: 0,30 × naslov + 0,25 × položaj + 0,20 × rang učestalosti + 0,25 × naznaka djelovanja.
prominence.limitations: Jezični signali mogu pogrešno pripisati izjavu ili ulogu instituciji.

reach.title: Potencijalni doseg
reach.meaning: Procjena potencijalne publike objave. Doprinos objave uzima u obzir veličinu potencijalne publike.
reach.construction: Doseg relevantne institucionalne objave množi se njezinom istaknutošću.
reach.limitations: Publike se mogu preklapati; doseg ne mjeri stvarno čitanje.

share.title: Ponderirana vidljivost
share.meaning: Ponderirani institucionalni udio u raspravi o inflaciji. Povezuje institucionalnu zastupljenost s veličinom šire rasprave.
share.construction: 100 × zbroj institucionalne istaknutosti × doseg, podijeljeno sa (zbroj dosega inflacijskog korpusa + 1). Jedinica: postotak.
share.limitations: Rast nazivnika može smanjiti udio i uz nepromijenjenu institucionalnu zastupljenost.

gap.title: Jaz u pažnji
gap.meaning: Vidljivost iskazana u odnosu na fiksnu povijesnu referencu. Povezuje prikaz s terminologijom rukopisa.
gap.construction: Referentni udio minus tekući udio, u postotnim bodovima. Veći jaz znači manju vidljivost.

centrality.title: Mrežna centralnost
centrality.meaning: Položaj institucije među akterima koje povezuju medijski izvori. Opisuje položaj u mreži, zasebno od udjela u zastupljenosti.
centrality.construction: Veća težina pripada vezama s dobro povezanim akterima; vrijednost se normalizira u svakoj mjesečnoj mreži.
centrality.limitations: Sastav mreže i normalizacija mogu mijenjati vrijednost; pokazatelj nije mjera povjerenja.

expectations.title: Potrošačka očekivanja
expectations.meaning: Mjesečni anketni saldo očekivanog kretanja cijena. Ispituje vezu s ishodom koji je odvojen od medijske zastupljenosti.
expectations.construction: Mjesečne projekcije uspoređuju se s tjednim modelima uz linearno ili stepenasto pridruživanje ankete.
expectations.limitations: Pridruživanje tjednima ne stvara nove odgovore; saldo nije mjera dugoročne usidrenosti.

article.title: Udio objava
article.meaning: Koliko institucionalnih objava relevantnih za inflaciju ima u odnosu na inflacijski korpus?
article.construction: 100 × broj relevantnih institucionalnih objava / (broj inflacijskih objava + 1), bez ponderiranja istaknutošću ili dosegom.
article.limitations: Broje se pojedinačne objave; prenošenje teksta ne predstavlja neovisnu uredničku pozornost.

hhi.title: Koncentracija institucionalnog pondera
hhi.meaning: Koliko je brojnik vidljivosti koncentriran među oznakama izvora?
hhi.construction: Zbroj kvadrata udjela izvora u brojniku istaknutost × doseg. Vrijednost 1 znači da jedan izvor nosi sav ponder.
hhi.limitations: Oznake izvora nisu nužno neovisni brendovi ili vlasnici. Ova dijagnostika ponderiranog brojnika razlikuje se od HHI-ja ukupnog dosega korištenog kao kontrola u regresiji.

findings.finding: Higher inflation is associated with lower weighted visibility in the primary weekly model; time-control sensitivity qualifies the association.
findings.finding_hr: U primarnom tjednom modelu viša inflacija povezana je s nižom ponderiranom vidljivošću; osjetljivost na vremenske kontrole ograničava zaključak.

findings.finding: Weighted visibility declines within April 2024–May 2026 in the primary and common-source monthly trend models.
findings.finding_hr: Od travnja 2024. do svibnja 2026. ponderirana vidljivost pada u mjesečnim modelima primarnog uzorka i zajedničkih izvora.

findings.model: Forward projections; article-share exposure; continuity controls
findings.finding: A stable predictive relationship with consumer expectations is not established; survey assignment and model controls affect the results.
findings.finding_hr: Stabilna prediktivna veza s potrošačkim očekivanjima nije utvrđena; vremensko pridruživanje ankete i kontrole mijenjaju rezultate.
findings.model_hr: Projekcije budućih ishoda; udio objava; osnovne kontrole

findings.finding: The common-source monthly centrality interval includes zero; a lasting decline in network position is not established.
findings.finding_hr: Interval mjesečnog trenda centralnosti zajedničkih izvora obuhvaća nulu; trajni pad mrežnog položaja nije utvrđen.

common_source_definition.rule: Intersection of source labels with institutional items in both reference windows; restrict both numerator and denominator.
